 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Return the top-left quarter of the centered 8x8 pattern."""
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value != 0]
    min_r = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    min_c = min(c for _, c in cells)
    max_r = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    max_c = max(c for _, c in cells)
    height = (max_r - min_r + 1) // 2
    width = (max_c - min_c + 1) // 2
    return [row[min_c:min_c + width] for row in grid[min_r:min_r + height]]
